title: WTHIT: PotionCraft
description: A simple WTHIT/WAILA plugin to display PotionCraft cauldron properties.
body: A simple WTHIT/WAILA plugin to display PotionCraft cauldron properties. ## Features Displays fluid contents and effects, with icons, effect names, and durations. ## Acknowlegements Icon: Cauldron by Sabda Vinsmoke from Noun Project (CC BY 3.0) Icon: Magnifying Glass by Liberus from Noun Project (CC BY 3.0) Magnifying Glass by Liberus from Noun Project (CC BY 3.0)
